newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Permanent raises variable rates 50 basis points. [corrected 22:54 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Irish Permanent raises variable rates 50 basis points. [corrected 22:54 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects rise from 0.5 percent to 50 basis points.)
Irish Permanent Plc on Tuesday said it was raising its variable loan rates by 50 basis points.
The move followed a 50 basis point rise in official Short Term Facility Rates (STF) by the central bank on May 1.
Irish Permanent said in a statement that its new variable annuity rate will now be 7.5 percent and its three year fixed rate was raised to 7.25 percent from 6.95 percent.
